== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Working Much More Closely]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. [[Working Much More Closely (Errata)]] (the 2 January 2023 remaster: same words, type and mark) shares the Original column. The 2024 errata replaced the whole game text, so all of it is highlighted. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
